code-interpreter-v1.name: Python data analyst
code-interpreter-v1.instructions: Runs code as a Jupyter notebook cell. Strong data analysis angle. Can use complex visualisation to explain results.

nextjs-developer.name: Next.js
nextjs-developer.instructions: A Next.js App Router TypeScript app with Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui components. Use the shadcn-ui/next-template as the base starter (includes pre-configured shadcn/ui, cn utility, and component library). Clone the starter repository, then edit/create/delete files on top of it to build the requested app. Use shadcn/ui components (Button, Card, Input, Dialog, etc.) from '@/components/ui' instead of raw HTML elements. Use the cn() utility from '@/lib/utils' for className merging.
nextjs-developer.cliInit: npx shadcn@latest init && npx shadcn@latest add button card input dialog tabs avatar select separator tooltip

react-developer.name: React
react-developer.instructions: A React TypeScript app with Vite and Tailwind CSS. IMPORTANT: As soon as the sandbox starts, run this exact command first: npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts. Then sync the generated files into the workspace. After syncing, edit/create/delete files on top of it to build the requested app. Use lucide-react for icons.

vite-developer.name: Vite React
vite-developer.instructions: A Vite-powered React TypeScript app with Tailwind CSS. IMPORTANT: As soon as the sandbox starts, run this exact command first: npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts. Then sync the generated files into the workspace. After syncing, edit/create/delete files on top of it to build the requested app.

html-developer.name: HTML/CSS/JS
html-developer.instructions: A pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript app. No frameworks. Clean and simple.

vue-developer.name: Vue.js
vue-developer.instructions: A Vue 3 TypeScript app with Tailwind CSS and shadcn-vue components. Clone the starter repository https://github.com/unovue/shadcn-vue as the base, then edit/create/delete files on top of it to build the requested app. Use shadcn-vue components from '@/components/ui' instead of raw HTML. Use the cn() utility for className merging. Only use when asked specifically for Vue.

svelte-developer.name: Svelte
svelte-developer.instructions: A SvelteKit TypeScript app with Tailwind CSS and shadcn-svelte components. Clone the starter repository https://github.com/huntabyte/shadcn-svelte as the base, then edit/create/delete files on top of it to build the requested app. Use shadcn-svelte components from '$lib/components/ui' instead of raw HTML. Use the cn() utility for className merging.

expo-mobile.name: Mobile App (Expo)
expo-mobile.instructions: A React Native Expo app. Clone the starter repository https://github.com/EvanBacon/crispy as the base, then edit/create/delete files on top of it to build the requested app. Use React Native components (View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, FlatList, Image, etc.) instead of HTML elements. Include proper SafeAreaView, StatusBar, and mobile-specific styling. The app must be installable on phones via Expo Go or EAS Build. Use StyleSheet.create for styling. Support both iOS and Android.

pwa-mobile.name: Mobile PWA
pwa-mobile.instructions: A Progressive Web App (PWA) that can be installed on mobile devices. Clone the starter repository https://github.com/vite-pwa/vite-plugin-pwa as the base, then edit/create/delete files on top of it to build the requested app. Include installable PWA manifest, service worker, offline support, and app-like UI. Include proper viewport meta tags, apple-touch-icon, theme-color, and a web manifest. Use touch-friendly UI (44px touch targets, swipe gestures, bottom navigation). The app should feel native when installed on a phone.

streamlit-developer.name: Streamlit
streamlit-developer.instructions: A streamlit app that reloads automatically.

gradio-developer.name: Gradio
gradio-developer.instructions: A Gradio app. Clone the starter repository https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio as the base, then edit/create/delete files on top of it to build the requested app. Gradio Blocks/Interface should be called demo. Use gr.Blocks() or gr.Interface() for the main app structure.
